facts.business: Biofil Chemicals and Pharmaceuticals Limited operates in the pharmaceutical and chemicals segments, engaged in manufacturing and trading of pharmaceutical products and chemicals.
key_risks: Revenue recognition risk due to variety of terms defining transfer of control and high value transactions
Risk of incorrect recording of discounts and rebates requiring estimation
Related party transactions with group concerns and key management personnel
facts.related_party_note: Related party transactions include sales to Cyano Pharma Private Limited (Rs 241.25 lacs) and Formoplast Private Limited, purchases from Cyano Pharma (Rs 62.74 lacs) and Formoplast (Rs 79.83 lacs), asset sales to Cyano Pharma (Rs 215 lacs) and Formoplast (Rs 200 lacs), salary to KMPs and relatives, borrowings from MID (India) Pharmaceuticals Private Limited (Rs 40 lacs repaid) and interest thereon (Rs 0.90 lacs).
